name: CRITICAL WARNING: Panera Broccoli Cheddar Soup in Sourdough Bread Bowl
whyItWorks: CLINICAL WARNING: A famous IBD disaster. Combines 40g+ heavy dairy fat and lactose from heavy whipping cream, thousands of milligrams of sodium, thick starch emulsifiers, raw chopped broccoli florets/stems (insoluble raffinose sulfur bomb), and a 1-pound dense sourdough bowl. Severe gas spasms and urgent diarrhea guaranteed.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never order Broccoli Cheddar Soup or Bread Bowls. Stick to Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup in a standard cup.
